title: metabinR
text: metabinR performs abundance- composition-based binning metagenomic samples directly FASTA FASTQ files. Abundance-based binning (AB) analyzes long k-mers (k > 8); composition-based binning (CB) analyzes short k-mers (k < 8); hierarchical binning (ABxCB) chains two. heavy lifting implemented Java called via rJava. v2.0.0 R API returns S4 MetabinResult object accepts Biostrings / ShortRead inputs addition file paths.

title: metabinR
text: JDK (Java >= 17) must available installing metabinR.
code: if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))     install.packages("BiocManager") BiocManager::install("metabinR")

title: metabinR
text: JVM flags passed java.parameters option. -Xmx flag controls maximum heap: -Xmx1500M -Xmx3G, etc. Set loading package. customise additional JVM flags (top -Xmx heap setting), set options(metabinR.jvm.flags = c("-XX:+UseG1GC", ...)) package loaded. defaults returned metabinR_jvm_options() already enable G1GC string deduplication.
code: options(java.parameters = "-Xmx1500M") library(metabinR) library(data.table) library(dplyr) library(ggplot2) library(gridExtra) library(cvms) library(sabre) library(Biostrings)

title: metabinR
text: binning function returns MetabinResult S4 object: assignments(res) — DataFrame per-read cluster assignments. nClusters(res) — number clusters produced. parameters(res) — list parameters actually used. algorithm(res) — "AB", "CB", "ABxCB". .data.frame(res) — v1.x tabular layout back-compat.

title: metabinR
text: toy simulated metagenome contains 26,664 Illumina reads (13,332 pairs 2x150bp) sampled 10 bacterial genomes across two abundance classes (high vs. low). Abundance ground truth: Read-level ground truth: Run abundance-based binning 10-mers 2 clusters: res.AB MetabinResult. Extract per-read table pull cluster labels : abundance_based_binning() wrote one FASTA per cluster k-mer count histogram:  Evaluate abundance-class ground truth:  AB binning evaluation
code: abundances <- read.table(     system.file("extdata", "distribution_0.txt", package = "metabinR"),     col.names = c("genome_id", "abundance", "AB_id")) reads.mapping <- fread(         system.file("extdata", "reads_mapping.tsv.gz", package = "metabinR")) %>%     merge(abundances[, c("genome_id", "AB_id")], by = "genome_id") %>%     arrange(anonymous_read_id) res.AB <- abundance_based_binning(     system.file("extdata", "reads.metagenome.fasta.gz", package = "metabinR"),     numOfClustersAB = 2,     kMerSizeAB = 10,     dryRun = FALSE,     outputAB = "vignette" ) res.AB #> MetabinResult (AB) #>   reads:     26,664 #>   clusters:  2 #>   inputs:    1 file(s) #>     - /home/runner/work/_temp/Library/metabinR/extdata/reads.metagenome.fasta.gz assignments.AB <- as.data.frame(res.AB) %>% arrange(read_id) histogram.AB <- read.table("vignette__AB.histogram.tsv", header = TRUE) ggplot(histogram.AB, aes(x = counts, y = frequency)) +     geom_area() +     labs(title = "kmer counts histogram") +     theme_bw() eval.AB.cvms <- cvms::evaluate(     data = data.frame(         prediction = as.character(assignments.AB$AB),         target = as.character(reads.mapping$AB_id),         stringsAsFactors = FALSE),     target_col = "target",     prediction_cols = "prediction",     type = "binomial" ) eval.AB.sabre <- sabre::vmeasure(     as.character(assignments.AB$AB),     as.character(reads.mapping$AB_id))  p <- cvms::plot_confusion_matrix(eval.AB.cvms) +     labs(title = "Confusion Matrix",          x = "Target Abundance Class",          y = "Predicted Abundance Class") tab <- as.data.frame(     c(         Accuracy    = round(eval.AB.cvms$Accuracy, 4),         Specificity = round(eval.AB.cvms$Specificity, 4),         Sensitivity = round(eval.AB.cvms$Sensitivity, 4),         Fscore      = round(eval.AB.cvms$F1, 4),         Kappa       = round(eval.AB.cvms$Kappa, 4),         Vmeasure    = round(eval.AB.sabre$v_measure, 4)     ) ) grid.arrange(p, ncol = 1) knitr::kable(tab, caption = "AB binning evaluation", col.names = NULL)

title: metabinR
text: Read-level ground truth (bacterial genome origin): Run composition-based binning 4-mers 10 clusters: pure clustering task, evaluate extrinsic measures: CB binning evaluation
code: reads.mapping <- fread(         system.file("extdata", "reads_mapping.tsv.gz", package = "metabinR")) %>%     arrange(anonymous_read_id) res.CB <- composition_based_binning(     system.file("extdata", "reads.metagenome.fasta.gz", package = "metabinR"),     numOfClustersCB = 10,     kMerSizeCB = 4,     dryRun = TRUE,     outputCB = "vignette" ) assignments.CB <- as.data.frame(res.CB) %>% arrange(read_id) eval.CB.sabre <- sabre::vmeasure(     as.character(assignments.CB$CB),     as.character(reads.mapping$genome_id)) tab <- as.data.frame(     c(         Vmeasure     = round(eval.CB.sabre$v_measure, 4),         Homogeneity  = round(eval.CB.sabre$homogeneity, 4),         Completeness = round(eval.CB.sabre$completeness, 4)     ) ) knitr::kable(tab, caption = "CB binning evaluation", col.names = NULL)

title: metabinR
text: ABxCB binning evaluation
code: res.ABxCB <- hierarchical_binning(     system.file("extdata", "reads.metagenome.fasta.gz", package = "metabinR"),     numOfClustersAB = 2,     kMerSizeAB = 10,     kMerSizeCB = 4,     dryRun = TRUE,     outputC = "vignette" ) assignments.ABxCB <- as.data.frame(res.ABxCB) %>% arrange(read_id)  eval.ABxCB.sabre <- sabre::vmeasure(     as.character(assignments.ABxCB$ABxCB),     as.character(reads.mapping$genome_id)) tab <- as.data.frame(     c(         Vmeasure     = round(eval.ABxCB.sabre$v_measure, 4),         Homogeneity  = round(eval.ABxCB.sabre$homogeneity, 4),         Completeness = round(eval.ABxCB.sabre$completeness, 4)     ) ) knitr::kable(tab, caption = "ABxCB binning evaluation", col.names = NULL)

title: metabinR
text: Instead path, can pass DNAStringSet, QualityScaledDNAStringSet, ShortReadQ. Java backend reads disk, non-file inputs staged tempfile transparently. Clean files written AB run:
code: reads <- Biostrings::readDNAStringSet(     system.file("extdata", "reads.metagenome.fasta.gz", package = "metabinR"))  res.AB.mem <- abundance_based_binning(     reads,     numOfClustersAB = 2,     kMerSizeAB = 10,     dryRun = TRUE ) identical(nrow(assignments(res.AB.mem)), nrow(assignments(res.AB))) #> [1] TRUE unlink("vignette__*")

title: Abundance and Compositional Based Binning of Metagenomes
text: Metagenomics holds great promises deepening knowledge key bacterial driven processes, metagenome assembly remains problematic, typically resulting representation biases discarding significant amounts non-redundant sequence information. order alleviate constraints assembly can impose downstream analyses, /increase fraction raw reads assembled via targeted assemblies relying pre-assembly binning steps, developed set binning modules evaluated combination new “assembly-free” binning protocol. goal metabinR provide functions performing abundance composition based binning metagenomic samples, directly FASTA FASTQ files. Abundance based binning performed analyzing sequences long kmers (k>8), whereas composition based binning performed utilizing short kmers (k<8).

title: Abundance and Compositional Based Binning of Metagenomes
text: Abundance based Binning module analyzes input fasta/fastq sequences long kmers (k>8), order capture differences abundance signal organisms input data. Initially kmer count dictionary created. efficient kmer counter implemented java backend. supports multi-threaded counting small memory footprint. expensive operation module, due exponential size kmer space (number distinct kmers 4^k). example number distinct 20mers one trillion. Next EM routine tries identify Poisson mixtures kmer count spectrum. Poisson distribution fitted abundance cluster. number abundance clusters automatically determined therefore needs user defined. characteristics fitted Poisson distribution linked abundance level taxa belonging abundance class total genome size. abundance class fitted Poisson distribution, vector structure kmer spectrum space constructed. vector kmer space also constructed input fasta sequence, utilizing tf*idf weighting scheme. Finally, cosine distance calculated input sequence vectors abundance class vectors. input sequence assigned abundance class least distance. module outputs fasta/fastq final cluster prefix__AB.n.fasta, containing sequences assigned . outputs well, file prefix__AB.assignments information assignment sequence (column read_id) cluster (column AB) distance sequence cluster (columns AB.n).

title: Abundance and Compositional Based Binning of Metagenomes
text: Composition based Binning module analyzes input sequences short kmers (k<8), capture differences composition signal finer details similar organisms input data. module involve expensive kmer counting step, since short kmer space relatively small. example number distinct 8mers around 60 thousands. every input sequence vector constructed kmer space. kmeans clustering algorithms run input vectors. Distance measure calculated Spearman footrule. efficient multi-threaded implementation kmeans algorithm provided java backend. number composition clusters automatically determined therefore needs user defined. Finally, input sequences assigned closest composition cluster. module outputs, AB module, fasta/fastq final cluster prefix__CB.n.fasta, containing sequences assigned . outputs well, file prefix__CB.assignments information assignment sequence (column read_id) cluster (column CB) distance sequence cluster (columns CB.n).

title: Abundance and Compositional Based Binning of Metagenomes
text: module performs hierarchical binning metagenomic samples, First analyzes sequences long kmer analysis (k>8), abundance_based_binning. AB bin, guesses number composition bins performs composition based binning short kmer analysis (k<8), composition_based_binning. module outputs, independent AB CB modules, fasta/fastq final cluster prefix__ABxCB.n.fasta, containing sequences assigned . Similarly AB CB module, outputs well, file prefix__ABxCB.assignments information assignment sequence (column read_id) cluster (column ABxCB) distance sequence cluster (columns ABxCB.n). also outputs file prefix__ABxCB.clustersDesign.tsv 3 columns. Column ABxCB id final hierarchical (step AB CB) bin. Column size number sequences assigned ABxCB bin. Column AB id parent Abundance based bin (AB) final ABxCB bin originated .

title: metabinR 2.0.0
text: three binning entry points — abundance_based_binning(), composition_based_binning(), hierarchical_binning() — now return MetabinResult S4 object instead plain data.frame. v1.x tabular layout available via .data.frame(result). Java backend longer exposes command-line interface; shaded JAR dropped commons-cli dependency. R supported entry point. Minimum Java runtime now 17 (previously 8).

title: metabinR 2.0.0
text: New MetabinResult class accessors assignments(), nClusters(), parameters(), algorithm(), plus show() .data.frame() methods. Binning functions accept, addition file paths, Biostrings::DNAStringSet, Biostrings::QualityScaledDNAStringSet, ShortRead::ShortReadQ objects. Non-file inputs staged tempfile Java backend runs. numOfThreads defaults BiocParallel::bpworkers(). metabinR_jvm_options() metabinR.jvm.flags option let users customise JVM flags load time without losing default G1GC + string-deduplication tuning. Parameter validation centralised via checkmate; errors surface cli::cli_abort() classed conditions (metabinR_error_*).

title: metabinR 2.0.0
text: Java sources build via Maven (java/metabinR/pom.xml, tools/build-jar.sh); shaded JAR reproducible (project.build.outputTimestamp pinned). Typed JNI entry points MTxAB, MTxCB, MTxABxCB return tab-separated assignments directly R, removing previous round-trip -disk CLI output.
